mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_incident WHERE incident_title = '报告AI连续失败进入降级' AND incident_status IN ('OPEN', 'INVESTIGATING') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_incident SET incident_status = 'RESOLVED', resolved_at = NOW(3), resolution_summary = '报告AI半开探测成功，服务已自动恢复', status_reason = 'REPORT_AI_RECOVERED', lifecycle_version = lifecycle_version + 1 WHERE incident_title = '报告AI连续失败进入降级' AND incident_status IN ('OPEN', 'INVESTIGATING')
